Hints.resourceUrl: The file to read, relative to the connection's address.
Hints.pollingEnabled: Whether this source re-reads on its own.
Hints.pollingInterval: How often it re-reads, in milliseconds.
Hints.skipRowsFromStart: How many lines at the top are not data - a title, a legend, a second header row.
Hints.skipRowsFromEnd: How many lines at the bottom are not data - a total row, a footnote.
